notes:
Summary: Synapse builds a conversational support layer that sits over multiple KBs (Zendesk, Confluence, internal wikis, S3-hosted PDFs). Evaluating Redwood for RAG + agent-assist to improve first-touch resolution and reduce MR (mean response) time.

Quoted from 2/18 call: "Need citations in agent UI — agent must see source, timestamp, confidence. Freshness is critical (weekly delta)."

Requirements (from buyer):
- RAG across heterogeneous sources: vector + metadata filters (product, region, version).
- Citation provenance in responses (link + snippet) and TTL/freshness control per source.
- In-session tool-calling: ticket create/update, escalate, attach KB citation. Must be auditable.
- Support spike reliability: Black Friday-like burst profile, target 400–600 qps read traffic during peak; p95 latency target <= 200ms for retrieval+rerank path.
- Cost sensitivity: want suggestions for quantized model variants and cache/batch heuristics — trade-offs documented.
- Model preferences: prefer open quantized chat models (Llama-3 / mix) but need fallback to hosted latest if failover required.
- Data controls: VPC private control plane or dedicated pools; strict retention rules for transcripts (90 days) and ability to auto-redact PII.

POC plan:
- Stage 1 (week 0–2): connect connectors (Zendesk + Confluence + S3 pdfs), ingest sample, baseline embedding quality (cosine + rerank).
- Stage 2 (week 3–4): build agent UI prototype with citations + tool-calling for ticket create/update; run 1k synthetic sessions with spike profile.
- Stage 3 (week 5): run latency/cost sweep (batch size, quantization, KV cache) and produce ops playbook.

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-10: Intro call w/ Jordan (AE) — high-level product fit confirmed.
- 2026-02-18: Deep dive (Fireflies ff_20260218_0923_synapse_eval_call) with engineering, support ops, and security. Collected connector list and sample export.
- 2026-02-25: Sent SRE spike profile + sample transcripts (drive link).
- 2026-03-03: Security questionnaire sent to Synapse; awaiting SOC2/ISO proof; they requested KMS integration notes.
- 2026-03-09: Demo of hosted RAG blueprint (Jordan + Carlos) — Synapse liked provenance UI but asked for per-source TTL and explicit fallback policy.

POC success metrics (client-provided):
- Increase agent first-resolve rate by >12% on sampled flows.
- Retrain/validate reranker to push true-source-in-top1 >= 85%.
- End-to-end median retrieval+response latency <= 180ms under 200 qps sustained, and graceful degradation plan beyond 500 qps.

Notes on technical risks / ask list:
- Need to validate memory footprint of embedding index for 5M doc chunks (est. 30–45B dims storage) — request Redwood sizing.
- Want examples of automatic partial-match suppression for stale KB pages.
- Compliance: require DPA + data residency addendum; legal wants timeline for Private control plane deployment.

- Budget mid-market band; procurement expected Apr 2026 if POC metrics met.

Files: pricing draft in drive, security questionnaire in drive, PO/contract template requested.
